blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) underlie state-of-the-art text-to-image models, but sampling them is expensive. Each image requires many denoising steps, and each step is dominated by the linear layers of the transformer blocks. Unlike autoregressive LLM decoding, which at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, a DiT forward pass is compute-bound. Weight-only quantization (e.g. W4A16) therefore reduces memory but not latency, because the low-bit weights are upcast to 16 bits before the matrix multiply, so activations must be quantized as well.
blocks.zh: 分流变压器(DiTs)(Peebles和Xie,2023年)是最先进的文本到图像模型的基础,但取样费用昂贵. 每个图像都需要许多去诺化步骤,每个步骤由变压器块的线性地层所主导. 与自递式LLM解码不同,在小批量尺寸上受内存带宽限制,DiT前行通路被计算出. 因此只重量化(如W4A16)会减少内存而不会延后,因为低位重被提升到16位后再被矩阵相乘,所以活化也必须被量化.

blocks.en: The post-training methods that do reach W4A4 on diffusion models all rely on calibration. A prompt set is run through the model to fit smoothing factors, clipping ranges, rotations, or error-compensating weight updates to the activation statistics of that specific model. SVDQuant ( Li et al., 2025 ) , for instance, migrates activation outliers into the weights using smoothing factors computed from COCO caption prompts, absorbs the magnified weight outliers in a 16-bit low-rank branch, and in its final version also applies GPTQ to the residual.
blocks.zh: 在扩散模型上确实达到W4A4的训练后方法都依赖于校正. 一个即时集通过模型运行,以适应平滑因素,剪接范围,旋转,或对该特定模型的激活统计进行误差补偿重量更新. 例如,SVDQuant(Li等,2025年)利用COCO标题提示所计算的平滑因子将活化离子迁移到重量上,吸收了16位低等分支中放大的重量出子,在最后版本中,GPTQ也适用于剩余部分.

blocks.en: Calibration has costs beyond its compute budget. It makes the quantized model depend on a dataset, it must be repeated for every model, fine-tune, and quantization configuration, and its quality depends on how well the calibration prompts and timesteps match the deployment distribution. Calibration-free methods that reach four-bit activations on image DiTs have appeared only recently (Sec. 2 ), and they evaluate on generation benchmarks that do not measure fidelity to the full-precision model.
blocks.zh: 校准费用超出其计算预算。 它使被分解的模型依赖于一个数据集,对于每一个模型,微调,和分解配置都必须重复,其质量取决于校正的提示和时间步与部署分布的相匹配程度. 在图像 DiTs 上达到四位活化的无校正方法直到最近才出现(Sec. 2),它们评价的生成基准并不测量对全精度模型的忠诚度.

blocks.en: Two properties of DiT activations make the calibration-free setting difficult. First, adaptive layer normalization shifts and rescales every token with conditioning-dependent parameters, so each activation vector carries a per-token mean. A normalized Hadamard rotation, the standard tool for spreading outliers, maps this component onto one or a few coordinates, and the resulting outlier sets the quantization range for the whole vector. Second, only regular Hadamard matrices, whose rows have equal sums, spread this component uniformly, and these exist only at orders n = 4 ​ u 2 n=4u^{2} . None of the hidden widths of PixArt- Σ \Sigma (1152), FLUX.1 (3072), and SANA-1.6B (2240) has this form, so rotation methods operate through block-structured or Kronecker constructions, which inherit the mean problem.
blocks.zh: DiT活化的两个属性使得校正-无校正设置变得困难. 首先,适应性地层正常化转移并用条件依赖的参数来调整每个令牌的大小,因此每个活化矢量都携带了每克的平均值. 一个正常的哈达玛德旋转, 扩展外线的标准工具, 将这个组件映射到一个或几个坐标上, 产生的外线设置了整个向量的量化范围。 第二,只有常规的Hadamard矩阵,其行的金额相等,将这一成分统一分布,这些元素只按命令n = 4 u 2 n = 4u^{2}存在. PixArt-\\Sigma(1152),FLUX.1(3072),SANA-1.6B(2240)等所隐藏的宽度都没有这种形式,因此自转方法通过块状结构或克罗内克构造来操作,而克罗内克结构继承了正问题.

blocks.en: We present CentriQ, a calibration-free W4A4 post-training quantization method for DiTs that addresses both properties directly. It subtracts the per-token mean before rotation, quantizes only the residual, and restores the mean exactly as a rank-1 term in the layer output, so the quantization range no longer depends on the offset. The centered activation is rotated by a deterministic factorized Hadamard matrix, and weights are quantized to grouped INT4 under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} ( p < 1 p<1 ) objective, so neither path uses calibration data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CentriQ,一种直接处理两个属性的DiTs的无校正W4A4后训练分数法. 它在旋转前会减去被切除的每克平均值,只将残基进行定量,并在层输出中将平均值完全恢复为一级名词,因此被切除范围不再依赖于相抵. 中心活化由确定分量的哈达马德矩阵所旋转,重量在强力的l p\ell\p}(p < 1 p<1)目标下被分解为组分INT4,所以两个路径都使用校正数据.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:

blocks.en: • We show that adaLN places a per-token mean in DiT activations, which a Hadamard rotation concentrates onto one or a few coordinates that set the quantization range (Figs. 1 and 2 ). • We show that after centering, the rotated operand, its per-token scale, and its quantization error contain no term that depends on the row sums of the rotation (Sec. 4.2 , App. C.5 ). blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Work on U-Net diffusion models showed that activation statistics drift with the timestep ( Li et al., 2023 ; Shang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; So et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Methods for diffusion transformers inherit this diagnosis and absorb the drift with calibration: PTQ4DiT ( Wu et al., 2024 ) weights salient channels by timestep, Q-DiT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and ViDiT-Q ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) use dynamic per-timestep or per-token activation scales, DiTAS ( Dong and Zhang, 2025 ) aggregates smoothing factors across timesteps, LRQ-DiT ( Yang et al., 2025 ) chooses rotations per layer from a calibrated metric, and AdaTSQ ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) allocates bit-widths along the trajectory with Fisher-weighted Hessian calibration. The fitted statistics belong to one checkpoint and sampler, so these methods must be refit when the model or guidance changes. Sampler-side corrections ( He et al., 2023 ; Ryu et al., 2026 ) act after quantization and are complementary to any quantizer, whereas training-based approaches ( He et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) fall outside the post-training setting.

blocks.en: SliceGPT ( Ashkboos et al., 2024a ) and QuaRot fold LayerNorm mean subtraction into the preceding weights, which is exact in LLMs. In a DiT, the adaLN modulation depends on the timestep and prompt and makes the mean vary per token, so this static fold does not apply. HadaNorm ( Federici et al., 2025 ) subtracts a per-channel mean computed over tokens at inference and applies SmoothQuant-style per-channel scales, fitted on a calibration set, before a Hadamard transform, and reports W4A4 on PixArt- Σ \Sigma . CentriQ removes the per-token mean instead and requires no calibration data. To our knowledge, no public implementation of HadaNorm is available, which precludes a direct comparison under our protocol. ConvRot ( Huang et al., 2025 ) spreads the mean with group-wise regular Hadamard transforms of order 4 k 4^{k} , which mix only within each group, whereas CentriQ removes the mean and mixes globally with factorized Hadamard matrices.

blocks.en: SVDQuant ( Li et al., 2025 ) was the first to reach reasonable 4-bit weights and activations on image DiTs, by keeping a low-rank branch in 16 bits after SmoothQuant-style migration ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) fit on captioned images, with fused kernels in Nunchaku. DiRotQ ( Sharify et al., 2026 ) preserves a calibration-derived PCA subspace of the activations at higher precision and quantizes weights with GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) , improving over SVDQuant on PixArt- Σ \Sigma under the MJHQ-30K protocol, which is not directly comparable with the MJHQ-5k protocol used here. HQ-DiT ( Liu and Zhang, 2024 ) reaches 4-bit operands with a floating-point grid.

blocks.en: On the weight side, RTN, NF4 ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) , HQQ ( Badri and Shaji, 2023 ) , and SINQ ( Müller et al., 2026 ) operate on the weight tensor alone. NF4 assumes near-Gaussian weights, HQQ fits the dense mode under an ℓ p \ell_{p} objective with p < 1 p<1 , and SINQ balances a second scale axis with Sinkhorn iterations. Calibration-free 4-bit activations on DiTs are recent. DVD-Quant ( Li et al., 2026 ) achieves W4A4 for video DiTs with grid refinement, rotated quantization, and adaptive bit switching. ConvRot achieves it on FLUX-family models with group-wise rotation, NVFP4 weights, and per-tensor FP8 activation scales. OrbitQuant ( Lee et al., 2026 ) quantizes weights and activations in a randomly permuted block-Hadamard basis with a Lloyd–Max codebook derived from the post-rotation marginal ( Zandieh et al., 2026 ) , and reports GenEval on FLUX.1 and Z-Image-Turbo down to W2A4. Neither image method removes the token mean, both mix within blocks whose order divides the width, and both evaluate on generation benchmarks that do not measure fidelity to the full-precision model.

OrbitQuant(Lee等,2026年)将重量和活化量在随机穿行的块-Hadamard基础上进行定量,并用出自旋转后边缘的Lloyd-Max编码本(Zandieh等,2026年),并将GenEval报告FLUX.1和Z-Image-Turbo下至W2A4. 两种图像方法都不去去去去符号的平均值,两种方法都混合在顺序会分出宽度的块内,两种方法都评价不测量对全精度模型的忠诚度的生成基准.

blocks.en: CentriQ is calibration-free on both axes and produces integer W4A4 operands for every transformer-block projection. blocks.en: 5.1 Latency results
blocks.zh: 5.1 延迟结果

blocks.en: We measure the latency of CentriQ at W4A4 on FLUX.1-schnell on a single A100-80GB GPU at 1024 × \times 1024 resolution and 4 4 denoising steps. The deployed model uses a single-pass activation quantization kernel together with Nunchaku’s 4-bit GEMMs. CentriQ generates an image in 1.69 s, whereas the BF16 model takes 1.77 s. The full calibration-free pipeline therefore runs slightly faster than the unquantized model as the time saved by the 4-bit matrix multiplication covers the cost of the added operations.
blocks.zh: 我们在FLUX.1-Schnell上测量CentriQ在W4A4的纬度,在一个单A100-80GB GPU上,在1024×\times 1024分辨率和4个去诺步骤上. 部署的模型使用单通活化量子内核同Nunchaku的4位GEMM一起. CentriQ生成1.69 s的图像,而BF16型则需要1.77 s. 因此,由于4位矩阵乘法节省的时间覆盖了所增加的操作费用,全校正无轨管道运行速度略快于未量化模型.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The per-token mean that CentriQ removes originates in the adaLN modulation, which all three conditioning designs share, so one activation path transfers across PixArt- Σ \Sigma , FLUX.1-schnell, and SANA-1.6B without per-model tuning. By Lemma 1 , none of the evaluated DiT widths admits a rotation that spreads this component uniformly, which makes explicit mean removal the direct remedy for Hadamard-based activation quantization in these models. Because the centered, rotated token contains no term that depends on the row sums of the rotation (Eq. ( 10 ), App. C.5 ), a single clip percentile, fixed once for all models and layers, reaches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: Per-token指CentriQ去除的发源于AdaLN调制,这三种调制设计都共享,因此一次激活路径的传输跨越了PixArt---\-Sigma,FLUX.1-schnell,以及SANA-1.6B,没有每个型号的调制. 根据Lemma 1, 被评价的 DiT 宽度中没有一个允许一个旋转, 将这个组件统一分布, 这明确意味着去除这些模型中基于Hadamard的活化量化的直接补救措施。 由于中心,旋转的符号中没有包含取决于旋转的行总和的名词(Eq. (10), App. C.5 ),一个单一的剪接百分位符,为所有模型和地层固定一次,在Tab中达到校正的SVDQuant的质量. 1 (英语).

blocks.en: The 2-bit configurations are evaluated on FLUX.1-schnell with simulated quantization, because no fused kernel yet supports 2-bit activations. Latency is measured on A100 integer tensor cores, and transferring CentriQ to the microscaling FP4 formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) of newer GPUs remains to be evaluated. The analysis targets DiTs conditioned through adaLN, which covers the three evaluated families, and the gain from centering is expected to be smaller in architectures whose activations carry little per-token mean.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion

blocks.en: We showed that adaptive layer normalization places a per-token mean in DiT activations, which a Hadamard rotation concentrates onto a few coordinates that dominate the quantization range. CentriQ centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 term, which makes the quantization range independent of the rotation, and it quantizes weights under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} objective, so no step requires calibration data. At W4A4, CentriQ matches calibrated SVDQuant on all three models, and its centering and rotation add no net latency over BF16 inference. On FLUX.1-schnell, it also retains usable image quality at W2A4 and extends calibration-free quantization to 2-bit activations. A fused kernel for 2-bit activations and an extension to video diffusion transformers are natural next steps.

blocks.en: Fidelity metrics measure agreement with the 16-bit output, not whether the quantized model still follows the prompt. We therefore evaluate compositional generation on FLUX.1-schnell with GenEval (Tab. 5 ). For completeness, the table also includes results reported by the concurrent preprint OrbitQuant ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . At W4A4, CentriQ preserves prompt adherence: its Overall score of 0.670 matches BF16 (0.667) and is close to our calibrated SVDQuant reproduction (0.682), although OrbitQuant and AdaTSQ score higher. Below four bits, the comparison favors CentriQ. At W2A4, the rotation and smoothing baselines collapse to near-zero scores, whereas CentriQ reaches 0.647, ahead of OrbitQuant (0.604) on every sub-task except Colors. At W4A2, CentriQ retains 0.573 and is the only calibration-free method reported in this regime. Because W2A4 outperforms W4A2 on every sub-task, activation precision limits compositional quality more than weight precision does, which supports the emphasis of Sec. 4 on the activation quantizer.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: CentriQ lowers the cost of running text-to-image models, which widens access for legitimate uses and for misuse alike. The quantized models inherit the safety behavior and biases of their 16-bit sources, and this work does not evaluate either. We collected no new data and ran no studies with human participants. All prompt sets come from public benchmarks and are used under their respective licenses.
blocks.zh: CentriQ 降低了运行文本到图像模型的成本,从而扩大了合法使用和被滥用的机会。 被量化的模型继承了它们16位来源的安全行为和偏见,而本作也没有评价. 我们没有收集任何新的数据,也没有与人类参与者一起进行研究。 所有快件都来自公共基准,并在各自的许可证下使用。
